topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can hardly believe it. All those long nights, the sweat and tears I poured into this invention, and now I find out someone else has already patented it. How is this even possible? They must have gone through the system faster, or maybe they had more resources, better connections. I did everything right, didn’t cut corners, followed every rule to the letter. Yet, here I am, with an invention that’s suddenly redundant. I need to figure out my next move, but right now, all I feel is the weight of this setback. It’s just not fair.
